value.title: Азимут A→B и коррекция
value.meaning: Two map taps define A/B independently from GPS. Magnetic azimuth subtracts WMM declination plus saved correction at A; near-zero range is undefined.
value.value_origin: Map projection -> A then B -> geodesic result -> WMM2025(A,time)+correction -> true-minus-declination normalize -> fields
value.units: WGS84 points, metres, clockwise magnetic degrees; distance<=0.01m undefined; correction degrees clamp[-180,180].
updates: Second tap computes; next tap resets A; correction change recomputes.
actions: Pick A/B; adjust/reset correction; Close clears temporary measurement.
conditions: Two-point azimuth mode/projection; input coordinates need no live GPS.
value.saved_state: Clamped correction string persists; temporary A/B separate from project features.
expectations: Phone movement cannot redefine fixed A/B. True90/effective declination10 yields magnetic80.
Counterexample: adding declination or taking GPS as A changes semantics; coincident A/B gives undefined bearing.
unknowns: Runtime NOT_RUN: no GUI, device, emulator, build or APK resource merge acceptance in this task.
